description: Factory floor kiosk. ISA-101 compliant. Zero interaction, zero scrolling. 1280x720. Redesigned from an earlier 1920x1080 layout (World-Class Audit Phase 5): template-variable pickers and the drill-down links row are hidden (hide:2 / links:[]) since a kiosk display has no one to interact with them; Temperature/Humidity compliance trend charts and the PE/JE-vs-spec bargauge were dropped from this variant after measuring that a 10-row Live Production table alone already consumes the full available height at Grafana's minimum table row size -- both are still on ims-ldi-manufacturing.json and ims-ldi-engineering-analytics.json for drill-down.

panels.title: $machine_id

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: always the true latest row per machine -- see v_ldi_machine_latest_full (migration 052), same pattern as the Live Production panel. ALARM (3) takes priority over every other state, including a machine that is currently running, since an alarming machine is more urgent than a clean-running one. */
SELECT CASE
  WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
    JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
    WHERE a.equipmentid = v.eqp_id AND m.severity IN ('Critical', 'Major')
      AND a.logdate > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  ) THEN 3
  WHEN NOT v.has_data OR v.is_stale THEN 0
  WHEN v.state THEN 2
  ELSE 1
END AS "$machine_id"
FROM public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full v
WHERE v.eqp_id = ${machine_id:sqlstring}

panels.description: Live ALARM/OK/IDLE/NO_DATA status for $machine_id. ALARM = a real Critical/Major alarm logged for this machine in the last 5 minutes (same window as the Active Alarms table and the same is_stale freshness convention used everywhere else in this system). Otherwise falls back to v_ldi_machine_latest_full's single latest row per machine. Repeats per the machine_id variable (whichever eqp_id values actually have rows in ldi_data), so this works unmodified in both real and mock data mode.

panels.title: $machine_id

SELECT mo AS "$machine_id" FROM public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full WHERE eqp_id = ${machine_id:sqlstring}

panels.title: ◉ Fleet Availability

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT-safe rewrite (World-Class QA, 2026-08-06): same
   DISTINCT-ON-vs-compressed-chunks fix as the "Machines Running" panel --
   see that panel's comment. */
WITH machines AS (
  SELECT device_id AS eqp_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='ldi' AND enabled AND device_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.state = true) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 0) AS value
FROM machines m
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT state FROM public.ldi_data d
  WHERE d.eqp_id = m.eqp_id AND $__timeFilter(d.time) AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY d.time DESC LIMIT 1
) l ON true

panels.description: Percent of the SELECTED registered+enabled LDI fleet (machine_id filter) currently OK (reporting AND running). Denominator is always the full selected machine registry, not just machines that happened to report -- a machine that goes completely silent now correctly drags this down instead of silently disappearing from both sides of the ratio.

panels.title: ◉ Critical Alarm Records (master-code matched)
panels.description: Note: Alarm durations and MTTR are not calculated as the source EAP system currently does not broadcast explicit alarm-clear events. Only occurrence times are logged. Duration estimation requires EAP team confirmation of clear/reset event availability. Active Alarms: count of unresolved alarms in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: ◉ Environmental Compliance

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT eqp_id) FILTER (WHERE temperature BETWEEN 20 AND 24 AND humidity BETWEEN 50 AND 60) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT eqp_id), 0))::NUMERIC, 0) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND temperature IS NOT NULL AND humidity IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Environmental Compliance: percentage of machines within safe temperature AND humidity.

panels.title: ◉ Machines Running

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT-safe rewrite (World-Class QA, 2026-08-06): DISTINCT ON
   over the full requested time range forced a full scan+sort of every chunk
   (221K+ rows for the 30-day worst case this budget check tests), and once
   TimescaleDB's compress_after policy started compressing older chunks that
   became a real regression -- a per-device LATERAL lookup uses the
   (eqp_id, time DESC) index to jump straight to each device's latest row
   instead, the same pattern already proven in v_ldi_machine_latest_full. */
WITH machines AS (
  SELECT device_id AS eqp_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='ldi' AND enabled AND device_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.state = true) AS value
FROM machines m
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT state FROM public.ldi_data d
  WHERE d.eqp_id = m.eqp_id AND $__timeFilter(d.time) AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY d.time DESC LIMIT 1
) l ON true

panels.description: Count of machines currently OK (reporting AND running), out of the selected registered fleet. A silent machine is NOT counted, same fix as Fleet Availability.

panels.description: Watchdog: re-queries the database every dashboard refresh cycle. If this panel stalls (the frontend refresh timer dying, the reported "requires F5" bug), it force-reloads the page automatically. See migration 065 for the TimescaleDB-side half of this fix.

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: trivial constant-time heartbeat query, no table scan. */
SELECT NOW() AS time, 1 AS value

panels.title: ◈ Action Queue (Critical/Major, last 5 min)

properties.value: Raw vendor category letter: A = general alarm, W = warning/advisory, E = servo/motion safety fault (always Critical severity).

targets.rawSql:
WITH real_alarms AS (
  SELECT a.equipmentid AS "Machine",
         m.severity AS "Severity",
         m.alarm_type AS "Alarm Type",
         m.alarm_msg AS "Alarm Msg",
         m.alarm_detail AS "Alarm Detail",
         a.factory AS "Factory",
         d.mo AS "MO",
         a.logdate AS "When",
         (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM a.logdate) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "When_ms",
         CASE
           WHEN NOW() - a.logdate < INTERVAL '1 hour'
             THEN GREATEST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT, 0)::TEXT || 'm'
           ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT || 'h' || LPAD(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (NOW() - a.logdate))::INT::TEXT, 2, '0') || 'm'
         END AS "Elapsed",
         /* Owner: static category->team mapping over the real RCA taxonomy
            (public.v_ldi_alarm_category, 14 live categories) -- proposed
            defaults, not yet operator-confirmed org routing. */
         CASE COALESCE(c.category, 'UNCLASSIFIED')
           WHEN 'VACUUM' THEN 'Maintenance'
           WHEN 'CAMERA' THEN 'Maintenance'
           WHEN 'MOTION' THEN 'Maintenance'
           WHEN 'MOTOR' THEN 'Maintenance'
           WHEN 'ENVIRONMENT' THEN 'Facility'
           WHEN 'NETWORK' THEN 'Automation'
           WHEN 'PLC' THEN 'Automation'
           WHEN 'COMMUNICATION' THEN 'Automation'
           WHEN 'DATABASE' THEN 'IT'
           WHEN 'ALIGNMENT' THEN 'Process Engineering'
           WHEN 'CALIBRATION' THEN 'Process Engineering'
           WHEN 'REGISTRATION' THEN 'Process Engineering'
           WHEN 'PROCESS' THEN 'Process Engineering'
           ELSE 'Maintenance'
         END AS "Owner"
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_data d ON d.log_id = a.related_log_id
  LEFT JOIN public.v_ldi_alarm_category c ON c.alarm_code = a.errorcode::TEXT
  WHERE m.severity IN ('Critical', 'Major')
    AND a.logdate > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
), with_action AS (
  SELECT "Machine","Severity","Alarm Type","Alarm Msg","Alarm Detail","Factory","MO","When","When_ms","Elapsed","Owner",
    CASE "Owner"
      WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 'CALL MAINT'
      WHEN 'Facility' THEN 'CHECK HVAC'
      WHEN 'Automation' THEN 'CHECK AUTOMATION'
      WHEN 'IT' THEN 'CALL IT'
      WHEN 'Process Engineering' THEN 'CHECK PROCESS'
    END AS "Action"
  FROM real_alarms
), combined AS (
  SELECT * FROM with_action
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL,'NONE',NULL,'NO ACTIVE CRITICAL/MAJOR ALARMS',NULL,NULL,NULL,NOW(),0,NULL,NULL,NULL
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM with_action)
)
SELECT * FROM combined
ORDER BY (CASE "Severity" WHEN 'Critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'Major' THEN 1 WHEN 'NONE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END), "When" DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.description: Real Critical/Major alarms from the last 5 minutes (matches the is_stale freshness window used everywhere else in this system), fleet-wide across the selected machines. Owner is derived from the real RCA category taxonomy (public.v_ldi_alarm_category, 14 live categories) via a static category->team mapping -- proposed defaults, review before treating as authoritative org routing. Action is a short imperative derived from Owner. Elapsed is time since the alarm fired (NOT alarm duration -- this system has no alarm-clear/reset event, so true downtime duration cannot be computed without inventing one). When the queue is empty the table shows a single green NO ACTIVE CRITICAL/MAJOR ALARMS row instead of a bare "No data" panel state. Click Machine or Alarm Msg to open the Machine Snapshot for that exact event.
